claim: Memory implementation must start from tool semantics, harness policy, memory tiers, and render boundaries — not from SQL tables. SQL is an implementation accelerator behind helpers, not the architecture.
summary: Do not start memory work from database schema design. Start from: what tools does the LLM need? What does each tool do? What are the memory tiers? What becomes model-visible and how? Design tools first; let BrainCaseDB schema follow from Slice A fixtures.
